# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.5 Module 19.5-A (Lithuania & Novgorod): Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_gem1_kernel_yearly) (oe_gem1_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v195_lit_nov.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_gem1_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_gem1_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_gem1_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gem1_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { is_rebel_country = no } }
			c:LIT = { oe_gem1_dispatch_lit_events = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:PLC c:PLC = { oe_gem1_is_lit_host = yes } }
			c:PLC = { oe_gem1_dispatch_lit_events = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:NOV c:NOV = { is_rebel_country = no } }
			c:NOV = { oe_gem1_dispatch_nov_events = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { oe_gem1_is_nov_host = yes } }
			c:RUS = { oe_gem1_dispatch_nov_events = yes }
		}
	}
}
